chapter: Leading the Basie band: music, rivals and recordings
title: A. G. Godley, drummer
summary: He confirms Godley played with Alphonso Trent and was a distinctive drummer.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: He used to mention a drummer named A. G. Godley.
That’s right, he played with Alphonso Trent.
He mentioned him as an innovator. What was he doing that was different at that time?

Yes he was. He was doing the same thing that the drummers are doing now. I didn’t get to play with him too much. Not being a drummer, I don’t know what he could be doing at that time. Whatever he did was unusual on the drums.
You noticed something different that he did.

Oh yeah, he had a style on the drums that he played. I guess, you could say that drummers have a style that they play. I don’t know how to define drummers too much because the only thing I know is a lot of them swing and a lot of them don’t.
You know when you hit a bad one.
